Remarks: D5: per-step failures are collected and surfaced via an aggregated PPDS.Migration.Import.PluginStepReenableException. Previously per-step failures were logged at Warning only; if the token expired mid-re-enable, plugins stayed quietly disabled post-&quot;successful&quot; import. Callers in TieredImporter.EnablePluginsAfterImportAsync catch this and push structured warnings into PPDS.Migration.Progress.IWarningCollector.
